description: Employee leave requests reviewed by a manager.

key.instructions: The leave request can be approved as submitted

not_key.instructions: The leave request cannot be approved as submitted

s2.instructions: The employee has enough leave days left

s3.instructions: The requested dates clash with a critical deadline

cases.state: Sam asks for 3 days off next week. Sam has 12 vacation days left and the team has no deadlines that week.
Sam asks for 3 days off next week. Sam has 1 vacation day left and the team has no deadlines that week.
Ines requests leave on 28-30 June. The annual audit she leads is due on 29 June, and she has 15 days left.
Ines requests leave on 6-8 July, after the annual audit she leads (due 29 June). She has 15 days left.
Omar asks for Friday off. He has 8 days left, there is no clash with any deadline, and his manager says there is no reason to refuse.
Omar asks for Friday off. He has 8 days left, but Friday is the product launch he is responsible for.
